mapper.select: select count(1) from corgi_user_detail where user_id = #{userId}

select `user_id` userId, `nickname`, `avatar`, avatar_status avatarStatus, `height`, `weight`, `desc`, `role`, `character`, `group`, `birthday`, `con`, `city`,l.im_id imId, l.tel_no telNo from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = d.user_id where d.user_id = #{userId}
select user_id userId, lat, lng from corgi_user_position where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update corgi_user_position set lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}, uptime = #{uptime}, pt=point(#{lng},#{lat}) where user_id = #{userId}
update corgi_user_position set uptime = #{uptime} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, l.tel_no telNo, l.im_id imId from corgi_user_position p left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = d.user_id where p.user_id in ${inValue}
select count(1) from corgi_user_position where uptime >= #{beginTime} and uptime <= #{endTime}
select count(1) from corgi_user_login where ctime like concat(#{date},'%')
